name.description: Display name of the employee, e.g. Claude Senior.

kind.description: llm: run by an LLM, which needs a provider and a model.

providerId.patternErrorMessage: must be kebab-case: lowercase letters and digits separated by single hyphens
providerId.description: Id of the LLM provider, i.e. the name of its folder in .aico/llm-providers, e.g. anthropic.

modelId.patternErrorMessage: must be kebab-case: lowercase letters and digits separated by single hyphens
modelId.description: Id of one of the provider's models in AICo, i.e. the name of its folder in .aico/llm-providers/<provider-id>/models, e.g. claude-opus-5-5. Not its apiId, the id the provider's API expects.

title: AICo employee
description: Configuration of an employee, run by an LLM, in .aico/employees/<employee-id>/config.json.
